input.title: Premium Thin & Light battery complaints: history, positioning responses and product outcomes

claims.text: Premium Thin & Light has the highest recent battery complaint rate, 6.9% [6.7%, 7.1%], versus Budget 3.8%, Gaming 3.4% and Mainstream 3.4%.

In Premium Thin & Light the battery complaint rate moved from 4.4% to 6.9% (diff +2.5%, CI +2.2% to +2.8%), labelled intensified_long_standing. Budget, Gaming and Mainstream show no material change. This is descriptive, and pooled rates can shift with product mix or comment composition.
The complaint was present in the baseline window (4.4% in 2021-M01..2022-M06), so it has been seen before in this segment and has intensified.

Documented positioning on battery life exists for P0113 (Altura Aero 13 G4, up to 20 hours), P0050 (Brevik Aero 14 G4, up to 17 hours) and P0120 (Corvane Lumen 14 G2, up to 18 hours, shared with the display). This is positioning, not proof that the need was solved.
Most other battery mentions in Premium Thin & Light documents were incidental, such as battery-saver features or spec-sheet figures, not positioning.
First observed sale (an estimate of market entry, not a verified launch date) is 2023-M10 for P0113 and 2023-M11 for P0050, both usable. P0120 is 2022-M04 but unreliable.
P0113 had a mean segment share of 18.09% over its first 12 months versus a cohort median of 3.88% (rank 1 of 15). This is descriptive share of segment and does not measure distribution or preference.
P0113's battery complaint rate was 3.2% versus a cohort median of 9.0%, lower than the cohort. This is an association only.

P0050's segment share was 5.66% versus a cohort median of 3.88%, not distinguishable, and 5.05% with price-and-volume months excluded. Its battery complaint rate was 8.8% versus 8.7%, with no detectable difference. Months 2024-M02 and 2024-M03 show an observed price-and-volume pattern, and promotion is not confirmed.
P0120 was not tested for sales or complaints because its first observed sale is unreliable. This is insufficient evidence.
Rubric grades: signal Moderate (E024); P0113 Moderate; P0050 Not supported; P0120 Insufficient. Moderate is the ceiling for observational data.

P0113's high share and low complaint rate could possibly reflect distribution or launch size, or comment volume and mix, rather than battery performance. The data contain no distribution, availability or preference measures, and no causal conclusion is supported. The evidence is mixed across products.

For human evaluation: P0113's battery-led positioning alongside lower complaints and higher share may merit a closer look. A placebo-theme check and a sensitivity test on cohort definition should come first. This is not evidence of a solved problem.

follow_ups: Run a placebo-theme complaint comparison (e.g. display) for P0113.
Rerun the P0050 comparison with P0113 excluded from the cohort.
Test sensitivity to cohort window and ASP tolerance.
Examine fixed-product battery complaint trends over time and comment counts per period.
Seek distribution or availability data outside this dataset.
